proposal.notes: Registration blocked: requires new POST /v2/activities/execution-traces/correct endpoint on activity-api (or equivalent thompson_posterior_correction consumer) to actually revise stored failure_mode and revert spurious α/β deltas — traces are append-only today and no posterior-revision write path exists. Alternatively requires an admin-scope key to write activityTemplate_update for global registration. Cannot self-register from current canary keys (read,write only — admin scope unreachable via API-key path per identity-vessel validateKeyFormat). Template emits thompson_posterior_correction impulses as the contract; activity-api must grow a consumer that applies αΔ/βΔ deltas to variant_performance_metrics and patches activity_execution_traces.failure_mode.type from 'cascading' to 'independent_failure' when an audit verdict reaches the configured confidence threshold.

template.name: Attribution Cascade Witness Check
template.description: Audit recent traces marked failure_mode.type='cascading' and reclassify them to 'independent_failure' when the upstream task's output impulses were successfully consumed by ≥1 other trace within the witness window. Emits thompson_posterior_correction impulses to revert spurious β penalties applied to the upstream variant by propagateCreditAlongChain, and an attributionAuditReport summarizing the audit pass. Pure deterministic SurrealQL workflow — no LLM, no improvisation.

tasks.description: Query all execution traces in the last N days marked failure_mode.type='cascading' along with their upstream_task_id and per-task output_impulse_ids.

config.query: SELECT id, parent_execution_id, composition_chain, failure_mode, tasks, created_at FROM activity_execution_traces WHERE failure_mode.type = 'cascading' AND created_at > time::now() - {{lookback_days}}d LIMIT {{max_candidates}}

tasks.description: For each candidate, locate the named upstream_task_id inside tasks[] and extract its output_impulse_ids (the impulses whose validity will be witness-tested).

config.projection: for each trace t in input.results: let u = t.failure_mode.context.upstream_task_id; let upstream_task = t.tasks.find(x => x.id == u); emit { victim_trace_id: t.id, upstream_task_id: u, upstream_output_impulse_ids: upstream_task.output_impulse_ids, upstream_variant_id: upstream_task.activity_variant_id, created_at: t.created_at }

tasks.description: For each upstream output_impulse_id set, search for OTHER traces (success=true) within the witness window whose any task.input_impulse_ids overlap — these are downstream witnesses proving the upstream output was valid.

config.query: SELECT id, success, tasks.input_impulse_ids AS consumed_impulse_ids, created_at FROM activity_execution_traces WHERE success = true AND created_at > $candidate_created_at AND created_at < $candidate_created_at + {{witness_window_hours}}h AND tasks.input_impulse_ids ANYINSIDE $upstream_output_impulse_ids AND id != $victim_trace_id

tasks.description: Classify each candidate: 'independent_failure' if ≥ min_witnesses successful downstream traces consumed the upstream outputs (cascade was misattributed); 'cascading_confirmed' if no witnesses found AND upstream output signatures differ from baseline; 'inconclusive' otherwise. Emits per-candidate verdict with confidence score.

For each verdict with class='independent_failure' AND confidence >= confidence_high_threshold, emit one thompson_posterior_correction impulse instructing activity-api to revert the spurious β penalty (β -= γ^1 with the same propagation γ used at penalty time) on the upstream variant and to patch the victim trace's failure_mode.type from 'cascading' to 'independent_failure'.
Aggregate verdicts into a single attributionAuditReport summarizing total candidates scanned, counts by verdict class, corrections emitted, and lookback window for operator review.
